PublicWish.title: PublicWish
PublicWish.description: A public wedding wish submitted by a guest to be displayed on the Royal Malay Palace Guestbook.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest submitting the wish.

relationship.description: Optional relationship or group label (e.g., Keluarga, Rakan).

message.description: The wedding wish or prayer text.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the wish was created.

PrivateWish.title: PrivateWish
PrivateWish.description: A private wedding wish visible only to the authenticated wedding host.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest submitting the private wish.

message.description: Private wedding wish or prayer text.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the private wish was created.

SharedAlbumPhoto.title: SharedAlbumPhoto
SharedAlbumPhoto.description: A compressed wedding photo shared by a guest or host in the public Shared Wedding Album.

uploaderName.description: Name of the guest or family member who uploaded the photo.

caption.description: Optional short caption or memory note accompanying the photo.

imageDataUrl.description: Compressed base64 image data URL resized client-side for fast viewing.

width.description: Pixel width of the compressed photo.

height.description: Pixel height of the compressed photo.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the photo was uploaded.

/public_wishes/{wishId}.description: Public guestbook wishes readable by all wedding invitation visitors.

/private_wishes/{wishId}.description: Private guestbook wishes readable and manageable only by the authenticated host.

/shared_album_photos/{photoId}.description: Shared wedding album photos readable and uploadable by guests, deletable by the authenticated host.
